title: Joint Distributions of Minimum and Maximum Angles on High-Dimensional Spheres
summary: Consider $n$ independent random vectors sampled from uniform distribution on $(p-1)$-dimensional unit sphere. This paper investigates the limiting joint distribution for the minimum and the maximum values of their pairwise angles. It proves that the minimum and the maximum angles are asymptotically independent when both $n$ and $p$ tend to infinity, which solves an open problem raised in Cai, Fan and Jiang (2013) [\emph{Journal of Machine Learning Research} 14, 1837-1864].
